en-US.author: Langbase, Inc.
en-US.description: The visual workspace for the Command Code coding agent.
en-US.longDescription: Command Code Desktop is the visual workspace for Command Code, a coding agent built around open models. It lets you open projects, follow agent activity as work streams in, review changes with line-level diffs, and manage Git commits and pushes without leaving the app. It also provides project and chat management, plan review with iterative feedback, an integrated project terminal, and settings for models, permissions, appearance, and shortcuts.
en-US.name: Command Code
en-US.releaseNotes:
[FEAT] Open a mini chat window from any app with Shift+Cmd+Space
[FEAT] A menu bar icon shows your agents and lets you answer them with no window open
[FEAT] Use Claude Code as an agent right in the chat
[FEAT] A roomier sidebar with a menu on every chat, and a clear sign when a chat is running or waiting for you
[FEAT] Snooze a chat for an hour, until tomorrow or until next week, and undo an archive
[FEAT] Choose which pages show in the sidebar, and optionally archive chats when their pull request merges
[FEAT] Search now finds settings and your other projects
[FEAT] Rename projects in the sidebar, and the new name shows in the title bar, project picker and date groups
[FEAT] New themes that are easier to read, and you can import a VS Code theme
[FEAT] Hold, edit, reorder and clear queued messages, with Undo
[FEAT] Send a pull request review thread or a failed check straight to the agent
[FEAT] The agent can see and use the terminal tabs beside the chat
[FEAT] Optional sidebar meters for your 5 hour and weekly usage
[FEAT] Read a skill before you install it, or import one from a local folder
[FEAT] Choose a default model for sub-agents in settings
[FEAT] Attach text and code files to a message, not only images
[FEAT] Markdown files open rendered in the file preview, with a toggle for the source
[FEAT] Right-click a file in file search to open it, reveal it or copy its path
[FEAT] Account details stay blurred until you hover them, and a setting turns this off
[IMP] DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now the default model
[IMP] Add Gemini 4 Carbon, Claude Fable 5.2, Muse Ember, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Ultrafast and Ling 3.1 Flash 1019 to the model picker
[IMP] Agents keep running when you close the last window, and quitting warns you first
[IMP] The app stays responsive on 8 GB machines and while long replies stream
[IMP] Empty pages say what is missing and how to fix it
[IMP] Toasts are easier to read and show whether something worked, needs a look or failed
[IMP] If saved app data gets damaged, it is kept and you can restore it in one click
[IMP] A setting to turn off usage data, explained when you first open the app
[IMP] The app asks before pushing to your default branch, and before a trusted project adds new tools
[IMP] Stronger security for untrusted projects and for the installed app
[IMP] Shorter installer file names
[FIX] Git actions no longer hang, and you can cancel a commit or push
[FIX] A run cut short by a crash or restart says why and keeps your first message
[FIX] Switching branches no longer loses uncommitted work, and Stash and switch is one click
[FIX] Saving a file keeps its line endings, and files in other encodings are never rewritten
[FIX] What you type is kept through Up, the send button and Esc, and approval cards no longer take your keystrokes
[FIX] You always hear or see when a chat finishes, and turning sounds off really silences them
[FIX] Deleting a running chat asks first
[FIX] Cmd+W closes the open tab before the window
[FIX] The chat no longer jumps up when a reply finishes on a slow machine
[FIX] Editing a provider you added keeps its model list as it was
[FIX] Attach project now gives the chat access to that project, and stays disabled until a chat is open
[FIX] Send now sends a queued message instead of only moving it up the queue
[FIX] Toasts no longer cover the send button

zh-CN.description: Command Code 编码智能体的可视化工作区。
zh-CN.longDescription: Command Code Desktop 是 Command Code 的可视化工作区。Command Code 是一款围绕开放模型构建的编码智能体。它让你可以打开项目、实时跟进智能体动态、通过行级差异审查变更，并在应用内管理 Git 提交与推送。它还提供项目与对话管理、计划审查与迭代反馈、集成的项目终端，以及模型、权限、外观和快捷键设置。
